_comment: Source images for the music visualizer (generate_visualizer_images.py). Every prompt gets `style` appended; the black background is keyed out to transparency afterwards, so only the glowing subject melts into the presets. Change a seed to re-roll one image. An image with "style": "<name>" uses that entry of `styles` (style and negative) instead.
style: Centered single subject, glowing with its own light, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, isolated on a pure solid black background, nothing else in the frame, generous black margin around the subject, no text, no watermark, no border.
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, gray background, gradient background, floor, ground, horizon, multiple subjects, blurry, low quality

intricate.style: Intricate, densely detailed surreal composition filling the frame, many small elements swirling around the central figure, chrome and glass reflections, crackling lightning and nebula light, deep pure black background between the elements, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, no text, no watermark, no border.
intricate.negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, gray background, gradient background, flat, simple, minimalist, empty, blurry, low quality

images.name: nebula_eye
